title: The Late Cipher
author: W. M. Montrose
blurb: Rafael Thackeray, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
